slice: BC strata, condo and apartment programs. Read from BC Hydro and betterhomesbc.ca pages on 2026-09-29. Not verified: BC Hydro's Heat pump retrofit guide for stratas (PDF too large to read), any noise or outdoor-unit rules, EV charger rebates for stratas.

facts.program: BC Hydro Condo and Apartment Rebate: heat pump
facts.claim: Up to $2,250 per suite for replacing electric heat with a heat pump
facts.amount: Mini-split $1,000; multi-split $750 per head, up to three heads (max $2,250)
facts.eligibility: Unit primarily heated by electricity; building is an apartment building, stacked townhome or multiplex of 6+ units, older than 12 months; HPCN installer; strata or co-op board approval before you request the pre-approval code; you are the BC Hydro account holder. Not for renters or households who qualify for the CleanBC condo rebate.
facts.dates: Pre-approval code valid 6 months; apply within 6 months of pre-approval
facts.notes: The often-quoted $2,500 is not on BC Hydro's page; the maximum shown is $2,250.

facts.program: BC Hydro Condo and Apartment Rebate: limited-time heat pump bonus
facts.claim: Up to $1,000 extra for air source heat pump upgrades, plus entry in a draw for three $5,000 prizes
facts.eligibility: Air source heat pump upgrades under the condo and apartment rebate
facts.dates: Work completed by Oct 31, 2026; application by Nov 30, 2026

facts.program: BC Hydro Condo and Apartment Rebate: heat pump water heater
facts.eligibility: Replaces an electric primary water heater; NEEA Tier 2 or higher; licensed contractor with GST number and BC business licence; strata or co-op board approval

facts.program: CleanBC Energy Savings Program: condo and apartment heat pump
facts.claim: Up to $5,000 (Income Level 1) or $4,000 (Income Level 2) per home
facts.eligibility: Income Level 1 or 2; primarily electric heat; assessed value at or under $754,000 (prorated for rentals and co-ops); apartment buildings up to 6 storeys, stacked townhomes, multiplexes of 6+ units; strata or co-op consent form completed by the strata corporation and submitted at pre-registration
facts.dates: Invoices dated on or after Jul 6, 2026; apply within 6 months of the invoice date; eligibility code valid for upgrades done within 3 months of approval
facts.notes: Income limits are the same as the CleanBC ESP Level 1 and 2 limits (household of four: $94,900 and $118,600).

facts.program: CleanBC Energy Savings Program: condo and apartment heat pump water heater
facts.claim: Up to $3,500 (Income Level 1) or $2,800 (Income Level 2) per home
facts.eligibility: Same as the condo and apartment heat pump rebate
facts.dates: Invoices dated on or after Jul 6, 2026

facts.program: BC Hydro Multi-Unit Residential Building Retrofit Program: electric-heated buildings
facts.claim: Heat pumps $1,000 per single-head, $800 per head multi-split, $1,200 per ton central; in-suite heat pump water heaters $2,000; windows $17 per sq ft
facts.eligibility: Purpose-built rental, condominium and equity co-op buildings three storeys or higher with common-area lighting and central mechanical systems, in BC Hydro territory; existing buildings only; the strata council or building representative applies through the Conservation and Energy Management Hub

facts.program: BC Hydro Multi-Unit Residential Building Retrofit Program: buildings heated by gas, oil or propane
facts.claim: Heat pumps $3,000 per single-head and $2,400 per head multi-split; electrical capacity upgrades $130 per tCO2e of lifetime greenhouse gas savings

facts.program: BC Hydro Multi-Unit Residential Building Retrofit Program: 30% bonus
facts.claim: 30% bonus on electrical energy efficiency projects, up to 100% of project cost; not for fossil fuel to electric conversions
facts.eligibility: Mechanical and lighting upgrades in eligible buildings
facts.dates: Submitted Sep 1, 2025 to Feb 12, 2027; implemented by Mar 14, 2028
